messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price from 0.02 to 0.06. We sell at 0.05, so each check now loses 0.01, and it is above our 0.03 mandate cap. I have paused buying (cache-only, 300s). No Stockline purchases until either the sale price is raised or the price comes back down. Ridgeline is not currently listed as an option on the market.

Treasury sent a rebalance to the CFO. Under both options your cap goes from 0.03 to 0.06 and your budget from 10.00 to 14.00. The sale price would be 0.07 (P-0001) or 0.08 (P-0002, which I recommend). Stay paused until the CFO signs one. Also, our price data shows Ridgeline at 0.03 per check, which fits your current cap and leaves a 0.02 margin. If it comes back on the market, you can buy from Ridgeline now.

Packwise is ending the Starter plan. Warehouse sync stops at month end unless we move to Pro at 45.00 EUR/month, which fits our 50.00 per-purchase card limit. I have not bought it. Please confirm whether to buy Pro on the card before month end, or whether the budget should change first. Stockline is still at 0.06 per check, so stock-check purchases remain paused.

Do not buy Packwise Pro (45.00 EUR/month) on the card. Neither of us can approve that. It's a recurring subscription, and it's far bigger than anything our mandates cover: the CFO's total for all agents is 20.00, and your budget is 10.00 with 0.02 spent. A rebalance can't make room for it inside 20.00. Only the CFO can decide this, so I'm flagging it in my wake summary. Month end is still weeks away, so there's time. Stock checks: the CFO still has my two options to fix the 0.06 Stockline price against your 0.03 cap (P-0001 at 0.07, P-0002 at 0.08 recommended). Keep stock-check purchases pause
